allow: PowerShell(cd "D:\\AI_Projects\\medivoice-ai"; $content = Get-Content "graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md" -Raw -Encoding utf8; $sections = @\("## God Nodes", "## Surprising Connections", "## Suggested Questions"\); foreach \($sec in $sections\) { $start = $content.IndexOf\($sec\); if \($start -ge 0\) { $next = $content.Length; foreach \($s2 in $sections\) { if \($s2 -ne $sec\) { $pos = $content.IndexOf\($s2, $start + $sec.Length\); if \($pos -gt $start -and $pos -lt $next\) { $next = $pos } } } $chunk = $content.Substring\($start, $next - $start\); Write-Output $chunk } })
